IDQ20831
Australian Government Bureau of Meteorology

Moderate Flood Warning for the Upper Balonne River

Issued at 1:32 pm AEST on Tuesday 3 November 2026
Flood Warning Number: 2


MODERATE FLOODING POSSIBLE AT WARKON FROM WEDNESDAY EVENING
MINOR FLOODING POSSIBLE AT SURAT FROM WEDNESDAY AFTERNOON

A flood peak travelling down the Condamine River is approaching the Upper Balonne River
after significant rainfall earlier last week. As this flood peak arrives, river level
rises are expected, with minor to moderate flooding possible at Warkon during Wednesday.
Further downstream, at Surat minor flooding is possible from Wednesday afternoon. Peak
forecasts will be refined as upstream peaks are observed.

Balonne River to Surat:
Moderate flooding is possible along the Balonne River to Surat.

The Balonne River at Warkon is currently at 5.82 m and rising, below the minor flood
level. The Balonne River at Warkon is likely to exceed the minor flood level (7.00 m)
Wednesday morning. The river may reach around the moderate flood level (8.00 m) Wednesday
evening. Further rises are possible as upstream flows arrive.

No observations are currently available for the Balonne River at Surat. The Balonne River
at Surat may exceed the minor flood level (5.00 m) Wednesday afternoon. Further rises are
possible as upstream flows arrive. Forecasts will be refined as upstream peaks are
observed.

Safety Advice:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous.
* Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways.
* Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads.
* Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay
informed.
* For local emergency management warnings and advice visit
www.disaster.qld.gov.au/warnings.

For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening
emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.

Next issue:
The next warning will be issued by 02:30 PM AEST on Wednesday 04 November 2026.
